name: Supporter Network - Nine Directions
description: The review deck Nicole opens: nine directions for the supporter recognition page, seven network readings plus two off-brief controls that drop the graph entirely. Every card is the real renderer at card size rather than a screenshot, so a thumbnail cannot drift from the direction it opens. Captured on Mobile as well as Desktop because the deck is shared as a link and a reviewer is as likely to open it on a phone — where the three-column grid has to collapse without the miniatures becoming unreadable. No seed: the page is fully self-contained, since a published artifact runs under a CSP that blocks every external host, so the 200 illustrative supporters are inlined rather than fetched.
